checks.text: The page displays the heading "Markdown Editor", a tab labelled "Write" and a tab labelled "Preview". The "Write" tab is active by default, showing the editor area and a status bar showing "0 words".
Typing `# Hello` into the editor area updates the status bar to show "1 words". Clicking the "Preview" tab shows the rendered heading "Hello" in the preview pane.

In the "Write" tab, typing `- [ ] Buy milk` and `- [ ] Walk dog` creates a task list. Clicking the "Preview" tab shows two unchecked checkboxes. Clicking the first checkbox in the preview changes the editor text to `- [x] Buy milk` and `- [ ] Walk dog`.

In the "Write" tab, typing `| Name | Age |` and `|------|-----|` and `| Alice | 30 |` creates a table. Clicking the "Preview" tab shows a table with the header cells "Name" and "Age", and a body cell "Alice".

In the "Write" tab, typing `**bold**` and clicking the "Preview" tab shows the text "bold" with a `strong` tag. Typing `*italic*` and clicking the "Preview" tab shows the text "italic" with an `em` tag.
In the "Write" tab, typing ` indented code` (four spaces) creates a code block. Clicking the "Preview" tab shows the text "indented code" inside a `pre` tag.
Clicking the "Export" button in the toolbar downloads a file named `document.md` containing the exact text currently in the editor.
In the "Write" tab, typing `# Test` and then pressing `Ctrl+Z` reverts the editor to its previous empty state, and the status bar shows "0 words".
Reload keeps the document text. After typing `# Saved` in the editor, reloading the page shows the editor containing `# Saved` and the status bar showing "1 words".
